title: Tenant request identity collation governed Dry Run

phases.objective: Execute the reviewed tenant-request identity collation migration through the governed authorization bootstrap and checksum-bound Dry Run lifecycle without making migration SQL Apply available, while preserving exact failure provenance and reconciling ambiguous envelope-create outcomes with a bounded SELECT-only ledger readback.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Trusted-main tooling records or reads back the checksum-bound authorization and verifies governed_migration_execute mode=dry_run with applies_sql=false; if envelope creation fails, the runner preserves sanitized nested failure evidence, classifies write outcome without false negatives, performs only an exact-run SELECT-only ledger reconciliation, and stops before approval/bootstrap/Dry Run continuation.
steps: Verify current main and Production refs contain source merge 894f112c452887e9c8f3f58fe55af598cb04af31 and Production exposes the reviewed migration blob.

Create a per-run requested_by correlation key from the GitHub run ID and attempt, mark the managed control-plane create outcome attempted_unknown before the request, and only mark it confirmed after a successful response.

If envelope creation fails, preserve sanitized HTTP status, payload, child stdout/stderr and transport evidence, then query capability_resolution_envelope_ledger through the shared read-only admin DB builder using only the exact per-run requested_by key.

Classify create failure as no_matching_row_after_failure, matching_row_persisted_response_failed, or reconciliation_unavailable and stop without envelope approval, authorization bootstrap, or governed migration execution.

On a successful create path, approve only when required, call governed_migration_authorization_bootstrap with the exact migration filename, checksum, statement count, source PR, source merge SHA, typed authorization confirmation, and envelope ID; require migration_sql_executed=false.
Call governed_migration_execute exactly once with mode=dry_run and the exact checksum and statement count.
Require mode=dry_run and applies_sql=false, persist sanitized evidence, and terminate without any Apply stage.
assertions: The workflow only accepts the exact Issue #4449 authorization token from OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR and checks out trusted main.
A control-plane create attempt is never reported as confirmed false merely because its HTTP response failed: the evidence exposes not_attempted, attempted_unknown, or confirmed outcome semantics.
Envelope-create failures retain sanitized nested response payload, stdout, stderr, transport and HTTP status evidence.
Failure reconciliation is SELECT-only, uses the shared governed admin DB read request builder, and is correlated to an exact GitHub run ID plus run attempt through requested_by.
A failed envelope-create response cannot proceed to envelope approval, authorization bootstrap, or governed_migration_execute.
The authorization bootstrap may persist authorization evidence but never executes target migration SQL.
The runner contains exactly one governed migration execution request and it is mode=dry_run.
No mode=apply or APPLY_20260808_TENANT_REQUEST_IDENTITY_COLLATION_ALIGNMENT confirmation exists in the runner or workflow.

The final evidence reports apply_authorized=false, apply_sent=false, migration_apply_executed=false, provider_call_executed=false, credential_payload_accessed=false, external_business_write_executed=false, and secrets_included=false.
